observed_reality: PR #404 V2 projection worker orders each event as assert_lease_v2 -> v1.apply_event -> renew_lease_v2.
projection_outbox_v1.apply_event commits derived ClayGraph state in a graph transaction and only afterward opens a separate UnifiedDB transaction to mark the event APPLIED.
PR #404 itself lists the assert-before-apply window as a strongest remaining counterhypothesis.
grf.generated_reality: A pre-apply lease assertion might be sufficient because generation changes are independently fenced by acquire/renew semantics.
grf.counter_reality: The current owner can pass assert_lease_v2, expire, lose the lease to a successor generation, and still commit one derived ClayGraph mutation before renew observes the loss.
grf.causal_mechanism: Lease ownership/generation lives in UnifiedDB while the derived graph commit is a separate database transaction. No generation-bearing commit fence spans the interval from lease validation through the derived commit.
hidden_assumptions: All successor lease acquisition uses the authoritative V2 acquire path on the same UnifiedDB file.
ClayGraph remains derived/rebuildable and does not itself mint semantic authority.
A repair must preserve crash/replay idempotency rather than claim cross-database atomic commit.
grf.falsifier: Admit successor B/gen2 after A/gen1 passes its lease assertion but before A performs the derived commit, then observe whether A/gen1 can still mutate the graph.
grf.predicted_if_preassert_is_sufficient: A/gen1 derived mutation is rejected or impossible after B/gen2 admission.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality_is_right: B/gen2 becomes authoritative while A/gen1 can still commit the derived mutation.

unusual_experiment.name: LEASE_TAKEOVER_BETWEEN_ASSERT_AND_GRAPH_COMMIT
unusual_experiment.baseline: A/gen1 asserted and committed while still the admitted generation.
unusual_experiment.treatment: A/gen1 asserted at boot-time 1050; after expiry B acquired gen2 at 1101; A/gen1 then committed the derived graph write.
unusual_experiment.sensitivity_control: A second authoritative lease check after B/gen2 admission rejects A/gen1 before graph mutation.
unusual_experiment.safety: No canonical Frank state, accepted VPS state, external provider effect, Harness authority or training authority was mutated.

repair_candidate.head: 5f18571f6b67371a255fe61f36d7042aa087e9a8
repair_candidate.mechanism: Hold BEGIN IMMEDIATE on authoritative UnifiedDB across exact V2 owner/generation/boot/expiry validation, one bounded derived-graph callback, optional in-transaction UnifiedDB acknowledgement, and authoritative commit. Since acquire_lease_v2 also requires BEGIN IMMEDIATE on that UnifiedDB file, successor generation admission cannot commit inside the protected interval.
repair_candidate.non_claim: This is not a cross-database atomic commit. Crash after graph commit and before UnifiedDB acknowledgement remains an idempotent replay/recovery obligation.
